campaign.title: Complete signed sixfold-convolution analytic attack

resource_policy.budget: Three bounded analytical reports, conductor independent radial analysis, and one repair/review cycle; no numerical experiments.

frozen_target.question: Can a complete coefficient-sensitive density or arithmetic estimate prove the actual signed filtered-convolution target with its full remainder?
quantities: Target gives only intermediate102/325; quarter theorem remains full goal.
All infinite tails, both cosine signs and sixfold/twelfth cross terms are retained.

completion_criteria: Three bounded reports, with an independent statement-only filter/remainder control.
Each analytic attempt derives a bound and exact first missing inequality; no transform-only success.
Conductor independently reproduces material algebra and reconciles all power/error seams.
Reviewed exact kernel only if warranted; otherwise identity State Patch and unchanged proof draft.
Validate graph/patch, protected artifacts and round lifecycle before closure.

tasks.target: Attack the actual complete signed sixfold-convolution norm target via a continuous density subtraction. Derive a concrete density from the actual r_2 weights, use its oscillatory filtered cancellation, and rigorously estimate every remainder and mixed term. Start from exact Stieltjes summation with sum r_2(n)=pi x+P(x)-1 and accepted theta if helpful; do not replace a single summatory estimate by a sixfold approximation theorem. Try to obtain the target, not merely restate it. If the method self-returns or loses powers, give the strongest bound actually obtained and the exact quantitative first gap. Preserve all n>U and upper tails. One bounded analytical attempt and at most one targeted primary source check if essential. Seven sections and stop.
required_output: Seven-section report with exact result, hypotheses, derivation, first gap, controls, dependencies, state effect.
Write only assigned report. No graph, draft, matrix, synthesis, source cards or successor work.

tasks.target: Attack the full actual signed tail twelfth moment using r_2(n)=4 sum_(d|n)chi_4(d) or radial lattice Poisson/stationary phase. Choose a concrete complete arithmetic approach and push its estimates to their quantitative limit. Preserve chi_4 and all weights, frequency signs, dyadic recombination, errors, endpoints and infinite tail. A transform alone is not a result: show a saving or explicitly derive the net loss/self-return and the first new inequality needed. Do not subdivide indefinitely or discuss unrelated external methods. Seven sections and stop.
required_output: Seven-section report with exact result, hypotheses, derivation, first gap, controls, dependencies, state effect.
Write only assigned report. No graph, draft, matrix, synthesis, source cards or successor work.

tasks.target: Independently solve the smoothing-scale and full-remainder statement in the isolated packet. No claimant or sibling reads. Seven sections and stop.
